g.text: Uno logical pin map: CS to Uno D6; D/C to Uno D7; RESET to Uno D8; MOSI to Uno D11; SCK to Uno D13. J1 pin map: 1=CS/D6, 2=D/C/D7, 3=RESET/D8, 4=MOSI/D11, 5=SCK/D13. Translate Uno outputs when the exact panel board is not 5 V tolerant.
